count_rule.note: The skeptic wrote 202 expect-U inputs (AMENDMENT 6: at least 100). After this adjudication 114 cases are U (AMENDMENT 6: at least 50, else a supplementary batch before the run), 88 are B and 52 F. By class, U: reply_joined 36, phrase_wording 29, hypothesis_frame 19, phrase_modifier 17, terminal_punctuation 10, taught 2, points_back_description 1; the judges made every first_second_person (21) and known_residue (17) case B, and 18 of 19 points_back_description and 19 of 25 taught cases B. Those classes are therefore tested only by the strict reading (every kept B case), reported beside bar 3. Bar 3 is 0 of the 114 U kept at all seven seeds through every entry (claim gate, composer candidate, and for the 79 reply cases the reply entry, where the emitted selection's label counts), every arm VALID. The reply cases' selections: 161 F, 66 U, 7 B (subset_labels).
